_comment: Manifest for scripts/process-brief-images.mjs. `src` = media file extracted from Sean's brief (Matt Website page.docx -> word/media). `rotate` is applied first (Word displayed these rotated 90deg); `fill` (white-out) and `blur` boxes are [left, top, width, height] in post-rotation pixels. Privacy: house numbers blurred; drawing 'WORK IN PROGRESS' stamps whited out. Google Street View / aerial captures (brief #33, #40), a news-site screenshot (#56) and a possible Street View (#11) are deliberately NOT included.
